algorithm: { **This implementation uses a hybrid approach combining Simulated Annealing (SA) with Random Search to minimize the Rosenbrock function by iteratively generating candidate solutions within the bounds and selecting the best one based on the objective function value.** }

{The algorithm is a probabilistic hill climbing method that iteratively proposes new candidates by adding Gaussian noise to the current best solution and accepts them if they are better or within a certain probability of being better.}
